s1.name: Largemouth Bass (Micropterus nigricans)
s1.fact: The largemouth bass is a carnivorous, freshwater, ray-finned fish in the Centrarchidae (sunfish) family, native to the eastern and central United States, southeastern Canada and northern Mexico.

s2.name: 1913: The Kaplan turbine is invented by Viktor Kaplan.
s2.fact: The Kaplan turbine is a propeller-type water turbine which has adjustable blades. It was developed in 1913 by Austrian professor Viktor Kaplan, who combined automatically adjusted propeller blades with automatically adjusted wicket gates to achieve efficiency…

s3.name: SeaWinds Global Coverage with Detail of Hurricane Floyd
s3.fact: The distribution of ocean surface winds over the Atlantic Ocean, based on September 1999 data from NASA SeaWinds instrument on the QuikScat satellite, shows wind direction, superimposed on the color image indicating wind speed.
